provenance.asset_description: A screenshot of the new Paizo store navigation and welcome banner. the navigation features the pazio logo, a search bar, an iconic to sign in to your account, an a cart icon. Below that is a blue car with the store category navigation; subscriptions, pathfinder, starfinder, virtual tabletop, accessories, other games, and merch. Under the full navigation is a banner showing off a wave of art from pathfinder and starfinder including locations, and dragons, overlayed over the banner art is text that says Welcome Adventurers.
